title: Natural-movie parcel-response encoding
disposition_reason: The task package contains a legacy producer/collection manifest for16 Movie10 transcript-development cases and explicitly no grader; its historical adapter paths are not delivered here. This is narrower than the full multimodal objective. Bind an executable source/target packet and independent scorer before using either scope.

scientific_target.question: Can a frozen stimulus-to-brain encoder predict measured parcel responses for complete unseen films/episodes in the four recorded people, beyond nuisance/time structure, under explicitly declared feature and hemodynamic context?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured BOLD time series for each source participant and ordered native parcel at each eligible held-out TR, not the published challenge score or output of another model.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Organizer per-person HDF5 neural response arrays; source documentation specifies samples×1000 parcels at TR1.49s. Actual held target arrays and their packet hashes have not been inspected or delivered by this package.
scientific_target.case_unit: A participant×whole held film/episode packet with all eligible time points and1000 native parcels. Manifest proposal covers four people×four films=16 development cases only.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Four people(sub-01,sub-02,sub-03,sub-05); films/segments/TRs/parcels are repeated observations and not additional people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Participant-specific stimulus encoding on public development data, with generalization across whole stimulus identities. A trained encoder score does not establish direct human-like understanding of fMRI or unrestricted new-person transfer.
exclusions: No claim that16 transcript-only Movie10 cases cover the complete Friends+Movie10 audiovisual objective.
No conflation of native ID and OOD scoring or hidden-test access.
No programme/native-understanding or causal stimulus mechanism conclusion from correlation.

inputs: Permitted frozen audio, visual and language feature families aligned to the source TR, with extractor/version/exposure and left/right context documented.
Training neural responses and native participant parcel order only; test sample count/shape may be public but held response values remain private.
A named narrower Movie10 transcript-input condition may be retained as development scope if its exact source and case roster are recovered.
forbidden_inputs: Held-film neural response values, answer-bearing target files, source result tables or memorized challenge submissions.
Repeated viewings/chunks of a held film in training; transforms fit on held response data.
Undeclared feature lookahead or hemodynamic context crossing held boundaries.
observation_contract.case_identity: Known source participants are sub-01,sub-02,sub-03,sub-05. Exact film/segment/run/TR and target parcel roster is not delivered; the legacy count16 is a proposal, not an authenticated emitted case list.
observation_contract.split: Prospective whole-film/episode grouping, including repeated viewings across all people, with frozen HRF/feature-context guard bands and training-only fitting. The manifest supplies a transcript-development scope but not a verified current split.
observation_contract.coverage: Legacy declaration:16 cases,four films,four people,1000 parcels,56 files per view and32 outputs. No payload, independently scored submission or complete multimodal source coverage is established. Conditions do not increase registration count.

primary.name: Mean held-film parcel Pearson correlation under a frozen OOD-style estimator
primary.aggregation: Proposed named OOD-style condition: concatenate eligible guarded segments within each film, correlate separately per native parcel, then equal means over films,parcels and people. Keep any ID Friends concatenation estimator separately named.
primary.rationale: Scores genuine withheld neural responses while respecting stimulus grouping and avoiding TR-rich film or participant domination; source manifest currently has no scorer.

secondary: Per-person and per-film correlation distributions with every native parcel retained.
Neural encoding gain over a fixed nuisance/time encoder and transcript-only reference on identical cases.
Complete coverage, alignment/lag sensitivity and constant/nonfinite prediction diagnostics.

comparators.name: Nuisance/time encoder
comparators.inputs: Predeclared within-segment time and permitted nonsemantic nuisance features
comparators.procedure: Prospective train-only regularized regression; freeze basis,lag and regularization before evaluation.

comparators.name: Transcript-only reference
comparators.inputs: Same permitted transcript embeddings and training BOLD as the legacy narrow condition
comparators.procedure: Prospective fixed reference, with explicit extractor exposure and whole-film split; no score is currently available.

comparators.name: Organizer multimodal encoding baseline
comparators.inputs: Source-permitted audiovisual/language features and training BOLD
comparators.procedure: Pinned organizer implementation is a reference route; authenticate native lags/trims and execute before claiming parity or competence.

nuisance_controls: Group each entire film identity and repeat viewings across participants; enforce temporal/feature-context guards.
Fit scaling,feature compression,hyperparameters and parcel decisions on training data only.
Keep1000 native parcels and distinguish ID from OOD aggregation rather than choosing the more favorable score.
Disclose model/media exposure and public development labels; local target restriction does not make source material unseen.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all four person values and descriptive paired person summaries; four people do not support precise population inference. Film/block dependence must be retained; no independent-TR or parcel bootstrap.
evaluation.failure_policy: Proposed scorer must require exact participant/film/TR/parcel joins and full predictions, reject nonfinite or undefined-correlation outputs, and retain missing cases as failed coverage. No score is issued by the current producer-only package.

implementation.scorer_target: No target scorer is present. The only registered-runtime member is a manifest declaring complete16-case producer/collection without grading; its entrypoint and source interface use unavailable historical paths.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source registration metadata for a narrower transcript-input development programme, not an executable full multimodal encoder or independent evaluator.
missing: Recover a present executable producer and exact protocol/case/source-target bindings for the named condition.
Implement/attach independent target scoring and fixed meaningful comparators, with ID/OOD scope explicit.
Verify authentic feature/target alignment, rights/exposure, participant boundary and complete scientific controls.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest states installed false,execution_selected false,status not_run and no scorer. This revision performs source inspection only; no model or authentic encoding result exists here.

direct_observation.representation: A future bounded numeric/visual stimulus-and-calibration packet could ask for neural-response predictions; the full1000-parcel encoding task is not already such an episode.
direct_observation.boundary: Use the same held stimulus identities and private neural targets; specify representation loss before comparison.
missing: No direct observer presentation or response collector.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed stimulus/neural calibration viewer is present. A viewer must not expose the held BOLD answers.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed actions and faithful permitted observations only; protect held labels and raw answers.
missing: Task-specific viewer, action limits and endpoint-preserving case representation.

tool_assisted.representation: Legacy manifest mentions programme production only, without delivered per-case investigation execution.
tool_assisted.boundary: Future tools must use the same observation and compute budget and no evaluator feedback.
missing: Present callable task implementation and isolated per-case transport.

frozen_program.representation: The manifest declares one frozen Python candidate source for16 transcript cases; the referenced producer and grader are not delivered in this task package.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze candidate and adaptation recipe before query access; a declaration alone is not execution.
missing: Recover current producer/collection path plus scorer and source bindings.

evidence.supports: Exact original registered scientific contract inspected before revision; binding preserves these bytes.
Explicitly no scorer,not_run,uninstalled16-case transcript producer declaration.
Verified organizer source facts distinguish biological extent,TR,ID/OOD estimators,repeat viewings and prospective deviations.

evidence.locator: Pinned organizer README; verified source mapping retained in NEURAL-040 source-provenance.json
evidence.supports: Four participants,1000 parcels,1.49s TR and repeated movie segments; public repository pointers are not loaded neural targets.

evidence.locator: Official ID/OOD evaluation documentation; retained verified source mapping
evidence.supports: Native ID Friends estimator concatenates episodes, while OOD computes within-film correlations and equal film/parcel/person means. These estimators are not interchangeable.

evidence.locator: Gifford et al., Algonauts2025 challenge paper; source identity retained in existing audit
evidence.supports: Defines multimodal natural-movie neural encoding and out-of-distribution generalization; not a direct observer or causal modality attribution result.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human result is established by the inspected task source. The repository historical neural pilot concerned NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077 programmes, not this task.
excluded_claims: No model/human score or empirical encoding improvement.
No full multimodal coverage from16 transcript cases or inference of direct observation understanding.

summary: Corrected the apparent programme capability to a manifest-only producer proposal with no target evaluator.
Bound known answers to measured BOLD and separated narrower transcript development from full multimodal encoding.
Specified meaningful whole-film references, biological aggregation and distinct ID/OOD estimator semantics.
revision.source_review: Original task and sole registered-runtime manifest inspected; reused primary-source mappings from the independently inspected NEURAL-040 implementation provenance. No authentic neural/media payload or historical external adapter was read.
